questions.prompt: Against a tighter early open, your continuing range should be…

choices.text: Wider than against a button open
Tighter than against a button open
Only the blinds are allowed to continue

questions.explanation: An early range is stronger, so you continue fewer hands than against a steal.

questions.prompt: Which spot is the best 3-bet, not a fold?

choices.text: Button versus a cutoff open, holding AK
UTG+1 versus an UTG open, holding 96o
Big blind versus an UTG open, holding 72o
Any hand, because 3-bets cannot be value

questions.explanation: AK is a value 3-bet against a late open. The trash hands fold.

questions.prompt: You called an open in position with 76s and completely missed the flop. Default?

choices.text: Stack off because you called preflop
Give up the pot unless you have a real reason to continue
The preflop call obligates you to see the river

questions.explanation: A preflop continue is not a promise to put in 100bb with no pair and no draw.

questions.prompt: Cutoff opens to 3bb. You are on the button with AKo. Folding is wrong because…

choices.text: The button must call every open
AKo is ahead of a cutoff open and should call or 3-bet

questions.explanation: This is a standard value continue, usually a 3-bet.
